hero.title: Elevate Your Study Sessions with Real-Time Collaboration
hero.subtitle: Connect with peers in structured study spaces, engage in live group discussions, test your knowledge with interactive quizzes, and master complex subjects together.

features.section_title: Everything You Need to Ace Your Exams
features.section_desc: StudyHype brings all your essential study tools into one cohesive, distraction-free environment designed for maximum focus and team productivity.

spotlight_1.title: Collaborative Study Spaces
spotlight_1.desc: Browse available study groups tailored exactly to your academic courses or launch private, invitation-only study hubs. Invite classmates, establish structured workspaces, and collaborate in real time without friction.
spotlight_1.highlight_2: Private study hubs with custom invite links
spotlight_1.highlight_3: Dedicated activity feeds for every study circle

spotlight_2.title: Real-Time Chat & Sharing
spotlight_2.desc: Engage in dynamic group discussions with blazing-fast messaging. Share comprehensive lecture summaries, solve challenging homework problems together, and exchange vital study notes instantly inside your group channels.
spotlight_2.highlight_1: Instant file sharing & rich note exchanges

bento_1.title: Interactive Quiz Sessions
bento_1.desc: Test your retention with timed multi-choice quizzes, instant grading, keyboard shortcuts (1–6 / A–F), and detailed performance analytics to verify exam readiness.

bento_2.title: Custom Exam & Quiz Editor
bento_2.desc: Empower your study circle by designing custom practice tests from scratch using our intuitive Quiz Editor. Set duration rules, add questions, and challenge classmates.

bento_3.title: Smart Timers & Tasks
bento_3.desc: Stay accountable with integrated study countdown timers and objective tracking. Organize daily goals, track completed sessions, and maintain peak momentum.

bento_4.title: Comprehensive Group Management
bento_4.desc: Manage your study circle with complete administrative precision. Oversee member roles, review join requests, organize group-wide quizzes, and cultivate an elite academic workspace.

workflow.section_desc: Get started in less than two minutes and transform how you prepare for exams and coursework.

step_1.title: Join or Create a Group
step_1.desc: Browse available study groups in your field or launch your own private workspace for your classmates and study buddies.

step_2.title: Collaborate & Discuss
step_2.desc: Hop into active study sessions, exchange ideas in real-time chat, upload study materials, and answer each other's questions.

step_3.title: Master with Quizzes
step_3.desc: Solidify your retention by playing community quizzes, tracking your exam scores, and building practice tests with the Exam Editor.

cta.title: Ready to Transform Your Study Experience?
cta.desc: Join thousands of students and learners who are already collaborating, sharing knowledge, and achieving higher exam scores on StudyHype.
